label: OpenRouter's public model list
note: Prices, context lengths and modalities for several hundred models across most providers, readable without an account. The single most useful thing available to somebody who has no keys yet.

label: OpenRouter, older field names
note: The same list read the way it was shaped before input_modalities existed. Kept as a second entry rather than as a fallback inside the first, so that whichever one still works can simply be the one left enabled.
